title: fix(plugin-list): a gallery card whose title field is a lookup draws the referenced name, not `[object Object]` (objectui#12188)
body:
Fixes #12188
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ObjectGallery`'s `renderCard` titled each card `String(item[titleField])`. A lookup value read through `$expand` is the related record, so the heading printed `[object Object]`. An unexpanded lookup printed the raw id. The cloud organization page's Members tab shows this at phone width: below 768 px (`useIsMobile`), `RelatedList` renders its rows as an `object-gallery` and titles each card with its first column, `sys_member.user_id`.

- **Heading content.** When the title field is in the reference-bearing family (`isExpandableFieldType` from `@object-ui/core`: `lookup`, `master_detail`, `tree`, `user`), the title renders through `getCellRenderer`. The field is enriched by the card's own `buildEnrichedField`. This is the path the card's detail rows (`renderFields`) and the desktop grid's cells already use. This adds no second lookup-to-label path: the cell names an embedded record, and the lookup cell fetches a bare id itself.
- **Title text.** The heading's tooltip, the cover and icon tile, and the placeholder seed need a string. They now read `getRecordDisplayName(objectDef, item, { titleField })`. That is the ADR-0079 resolver this card already used as its fallback. Its `titleField` option reads an embedded record through the record's display chain.
- **A plain text title is byte-identical.** The heading still holds only the bare text node.

Nothing published changes shape: no export, prop or type member. Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch.

### Visible consequences

- A lookup-titled card's heading now draws what the grid cell draws. If the host publishes `recordHref`, as the console does, the name is a link to the referenced record. The grid cell and this card's detail rows already link the same way. The link stops propagation: tapping the name opens the referenced record, and tapping anywhere else on the card opens the row's own record. A `user`-typed title draws the avatar and the name.
- The title text now follows the resolver's value rule. Surrounding spaces are trimmed. A whitespace-only value or a list value is not used as the title; the card falls back to the record's display name, as it already did for an empty title field. The changeset says so too.

## Premises measured (dispatch Zone 2)

- **H1, confirmed** on `26b0bd2`. The heading stringified the value raw, and `renderFields` already formatted values through `getCellRenderer`.
- **H2.** The text path is `getRecordDisplayName` with `titleField`. Both other candidates are module-private: `resolveRelatedLookupLabel` lives in `plugin-detail` and cannot be reached from this package, and the lookup cell's `resolveLookupRecordName` lives in `fields`. No helper was added.
- **H3, corrected.** The Members title column is `user_id`. `@objectstack/platform-objects` declares it in `sys-member.object.ts` as `Field.lookup('sys_user')`, so its type is `lookup`, not `user`.
  - On the production path, `record:related_list` passes no `data`, so `RelatedList` runs its own fetch and asks `$expand` for the reference family. The value reaches the card as an object, which is the `[object Object]` in the screenshot.
  - A backend that ignores `$expand` hands the card the bare id instead.
  - The card fixes both shapes: the lookup cell names the expanded record or fetches the bare id. `RelatedList` is unchanged.
  - **Not fixed: a `user`-typed title with a bare id**, which only a non-expanding backend produces. The user cell has no fetch, so the card draws the unresolved-reference marker beside the id. The grid draws the name from `RelatedList`'s batch map (`lookupLabels`, re-shaped by `resolveUserValue`). That fix would have to go in `RelatedList`'s mobile branch. ObjectStack never produces this case, because its read path expands `user`.
- **H4.** `ObjectGallery` reads the child object's definition through `useSettledSchema` with the `SchemaRendererContext` adapter. The console mounts that provider in `ConsoleShell`, and `RelatedList` hands the gallery `objectName: api`. If no definition is available, the content stays text, and the text still names an embedded record (pinned).
- **H6.** objectui#8395 changed DetailSection's copy action to `JSON.stringify` and left the value-to-text contract open. It did not add a lookup-to-text path, so nothing from it is reused here.

## Card-shaped layouts (H5)

| Layout | Verdict |
|---|---|
| Gallery card title (`ObjectGallery` `renderCard`): a standalone gallery, a gallery under `ListView`, and `RelatedList`'s phone-width view | Shares the path. **Fixed here.** |
| Gallery group header (the `ObjectGallery` `groupedItems` label, `String(val)`) | Does not share the title code. Reproduced: grouping a gallery by a lookup draws a group header that reads `[object Object]`. **Reported as a finding.** |
| Kanban card title (`ObjectKanban` `effectiveData` sets `title: resolvedTitle`; `KanbanImpl` draws `card.title`) | Does not share the code. Reproduced, and worse than this card: a board whose `cardTitle` is a lookup gets the expanded object as the title, React throws "Objects are not valid as a React child", and the board renders nothing. The standalone board expands every declared relation, so the object does arrive. **Reported as a finding.** |
| `RelatedList` with `type: 'list'` (`data-list`) | Never shows a lookup title. Nothing in this tree registers a `data-list` renderer, and the only production call site (`record:related_list`) passes `type="table"`. |
| `ObjectGrid`'s phone-width card view (its first column is the title) | Does not print `[object Object]`. It reads `coerceToSafeValue`, which names an expanded record by `name` or `label`. Separate code; an unexpanded id prints raw there. Noted below, not changed. |

## Tests

All readings are from the final head `867148d` unless a different commit is named.

- **New pin `plugin-list` `ObjectGallery.lookupTitle-12188.test.tsx`.** It renders the real registry and `SchemaRenderer` with the node `RelatedList`'s mobile branch emits. Cases: an object-shaped lookup, an id-shaped lookup, an object-shaped `user`, a standalone gallery that fetches its own rows, no definition available, and a plain-text control.
  - **Red on base, before the fix:** `Tests 5 failed | 1 passed (6)`, with only the control passing. Received `"[object Object]"` for the object shapes and `"u_id_shape"` for the id shape.
  - **After the fix:** `6 passed (6)`.
- **New pin `plugin-detail` `RelatedList.mobileLookupTitle-12188.test.tsx`: `4 passed`.** It is green on base by design. It pins the measured hand-off: at 375 px the node is an `object-gallery` titled `user_id` with `objectName: 'sys_member'`. An `$expand`-ed record and a bare id both reach the card unchanged. The node's keys are exactly the ones the `plugin-list` pin feeds. `@object-ui/plugin-detail` does not depend on `@object-ui/plugin-list`, so the real card cannot be mounted there; the two pins meet at the node shape.
- **Reverse verification, from the committed state at `2392a99`.** `ObjectGallery.tsx` was restored to its base blob (on disk: `renderTitleContent` 0 times, the old `String(item[titleField])` once). Result: `Tests 5 failed | 1 passed (6)`. It was then restored from `HEAD`: hash equal to that commit's blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The script restores through `trap`.
- **Partial ablation, same commit.** Disabling only the cell-render half reddens exactly the id-shape pin (`1 failed | 5 passed`, received `"u_id_shape"`). The text half alone covers the object shapes. Both halves are needed.
- **Targeted suites: `Test Files 57 passed (57)`, `Tests 341 passed (341)`.** This covers every `ObjectGallery*` file, `ListView.galleryOptionsBagCanonical-6152` and `ListView.readersRetired-6152`, every `RelatedList.*` file in `plugin-detail` (both new pins included), `DetailView.relatedEntryRetired-7997`, `RecordRelatedListRenderer.unresolvedIdentityFailClosed-8793`, `plugin-view` `ObjectView.galleryBlockNested-12053`, and `app-shell` `ObjectView.galleryBinding-7547` and `rowClickModifierPayloadForward-9462`.
- **`type-check` passes for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`** (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). `--listFilesOnly` confirms that each test project compiles its new pin.
- **Dependency-closure build passes:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --concurrency=2`, 12 of 12 tasks.
- **Package lint (`eslint .`) for both packages: 0 errors**, warnings only. Lint is not type-aware, and there is no warning ratchet.
- **Gates, all exit 0:** `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-overwrite`.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance item 1, the zh-CN screenshot of the Members tab at 375 px on staging, can only be taken once cloud's objectui pin carries this fix. It is the seat's follow-up after landing.
- The `user`-typed bare-id boundary above stays open: card and grid differ only on a backend that ignores `$expand`. Not filed.
- A non-reference title type (`select`, `date`, number and so on) still prints its stored value in the card heading, while the grid formats it. The triage ruling and this card cover lookups only, so this PR leaves those types alone. Observation; no producer was measured; carrier: none.
- `ObjectGrid`'s phone-width card prints a bare lookup id raw where the desktop cell resolves it. Observation; no reach was measured on an expanding backend; carrier: none.
- Nothing registers a `data-list` renderer. If a host passed `type: 'list'` to the exported `RelatedList`, it would draw the unknown-type panel. No in-tree producer does. Observation; carrier: none.
- Findings are cited by symbol, not by line address, per AGENTS.md commandment #11.
